data.narrative:
Skapion is a seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $36M to date, led by founders with deep domain expertise including former Rafael Air & Missile Defense leadership. The applicable peer universe comprises 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies, with broader context from 2 public Defense & Security comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 additional private peers including UFORCE, Anduril, and Helsing.

Two valuation methods triangulate on the company's worth. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $90M. Peer-median methodology across the 4-company comp set produces $700M, reflecting a range of $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in Defense & Security stage and technology focus.

Triangulation across these two methods supports a valuation range of $76.5M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $395M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects tension between Skapion's early funding history and valuations achieved by more mature Defense & Security peers. Key uncertainties include whether Skapion's founder pedigree and defensible IP warrant peer-premium multiples, and whether the broader Defense & Security sector multiple environment has shifted post-data collection.
